en: If you hate being captain, just quit.

jp:

en: So what? You're still you, right?

speaker: 巴
jp:

変わらない。アンタはちゃんと
ここにいるわ。

That's the one thing that won't
disappear or change. You're right here.

The cards are drawn to power,
and they gather together...

jp:
とは言え、まさか同時に三枚も

思わなかったがな。

Even so, I never thought I'd get to
lay eyes on three of them at once.

jp:
まあいい。

speaker: 冷たい瞳の男

speaker: 冷たい瞳の男
jp:

フッ、
物分かりがよくて助かるな。

speaker: 冷たい瞳の男

speaker: 冷たい瞳の男

blame your own carelessness.

speaker: 冷たい瞳の男

speaker: 冷たい瞳の男

speaker: 冷たい瞳の男

the card, he gained its power...!?

speaker: 白
jp:

現れるとは……。
en: To think that even one such as he would appear...

speaker: 白
jp:

札を射貫くなど！
なんたる{ruby:狼藉|ろうぜき}か！

...Bah, be that as it may, to shoot an
arrow through a card! What an outrage!

speaker: 巴
jp:
あ、そうだわ。
大丈夫なの、あれ？
en: Oh, that's right. Is that thing going to be okay?

speaker: 白
jp:

訳ではないからの。
性質上、問題は無い。

paper. By its nature, it suffers no harm.

speaker: 白
jp:
時間が経てば

Given time, it will even mend
itself... But that is not the point!!

speaker: 白
jp:

speaker: 長英
jp:
あ、あのう……
先輩方、いまのは一体……？
en:
U-um... Senpai, what in the
world was that just now...?

speaker: 長英
jp:
いや、その前に、
この嬢ちゃんは……？
en: No, wait, before that... Who's this little missy...?

speaker: 燈治
jp:

まあ、色々……な。
en: Uh... Well, it's... a long story, y'know.

speaker: 燈治
jp:
とにかく、
一旦ここを出ようぜ。
en: Anyway, let's get outta here for now.
